market_summary: Monday closed with the Nasdaq up 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4.7%, the best day since April 2025, after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. NVDA closed up 31.5%; memory and AI chips led (MU +19%, MRVL +18%, TSM +14%). Tuesday in Asia, Taiwan rose over 9% and the Kospi over 7%, while the Hang Seng slipped 0.4%. GPU rental rates kept rising through the selloff, H100 up about 7% in a week. Rates remain the headwind: a Fed hike on Dec 9 is still priced as likely and the 10-year sits near 5%.

headlines: Monday close: Nasdaq +6.5%, S&P +4.7%, best day since April 2025; NVDA closed +31.5%.
Chips carried it: MU +19%, MRVL +18%, TSM +14%; Taiwan +9% and Kospi +7% Tuesday.
GPU rents firm through the selloff: H100 index up about 7% in a week.
Dell and HP report Tue after US close = Wed morning AEDT.
